verdict.rationale: vLLM documents a CLI, but the evidence only shows commands for starting the OpenAI-compatible server, printing chat statistics and running benchmarks. Nothing shows CLI commands to search, download, list or delete models. Hugging Face integration is a host-platform model source, not a model-management CLI in vLLM itself, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, I can search, download, and manage models from a command-line interface
